items.title: 3 Financial Stocks Retail Investors Are Watching for Higher Cash Yields
items.summary: Short-term interest rates sit in the spotlight again as October CPI, PPI and a fresh round of AI-linked earnings feed into the Fed’s next move, and that puts money market fund providers and cash managers directly in the conversation. Investors watching every twist in inflation and rate expectations risk missing quieter shifts in cash yields and fee pools. items.title: AMP Q3 deep dive: advisor productivity and tech investments drive stable results amid competitive recruiting
items.summary: Financial services company Ameriprise Financial (NYSE:AMP) met Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q3 2026, with sales up 7.2% year on year to $5.08 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $11.26 per share was 4.3% below analysts’ consensus estimates.

items.summary: Ameriprise Financial just posted Q3 2026 results with adjusted operating earnings per share of about US$12.47, and the reaction was cool rather than euphoric. items.title: 2 value stocks with competitive advantages and 1 that underwhelm
items.summary: The low valuation multiples for value stocks provide a margin of safety that growth stocks rarely offer. However, the challenge lies in determining whether these cheap assets are genuinely undervalued or simply on sale due to their potentially deteriorating business models.
